title: LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policies are expected to generalize across deployment environments, including variations in the robot itself: cameras are bumped and remounted, calibrations drift, controllers run at different rates, and end-effector pads wear down. We present LIBERO-RIG, a benchmark that perturbs only the robot's hardware and setup while holding every LIBERO task fixed. The benchmark spans eleven perturbation axes, including camera mounting and optics, camera-to-arm calibration, actuation gain, control rate, proprioceptive noise, base pose, table height, and gripper pads. Each axis has five severity levels, yielding 210 conditions across the four LIBERO suites. We evaluate nine recent vision-language-action models using 500 episodes per condition and substantiate each finding with rigorous statistical tests. translated_title: LIBERO-RIG：一个面向视觉-语言-动作模型的硬件设置鲁棒性基准
translated_abstract: 机器人策略被期望能够在不同的部署环境之间泛化，其中包括机器人自身的变化：相机被碰撞后重新安装、标定发生漂移、控制器以不同的频率运行、末端执行器垫片磨损等。我们提出了LIBERO-RIG，这是一个仅在机器人的硬件和设置上进行扰动、同时保持所有LIBERO任务固定不变的基准。该基准涵盖十一个扰动轴，包括相机安装与光学特性、相机与机械臂之间的标定、执行增益、控制频率、本体感知噪声、基座位姿、桌面高度以及夹爪垫片。每个轴设有五个严重程度级别，在四个LIBERO任务套件中共产生210种测试条件。我们评估了九个近期的视觉-语言-动作模型，每种条件使用500个回合，并用严格的统计检验来证实每项发现。汇总成功率从0.932在中度严重程度下降至0.767，在最高严重程度下降至0.509。不同模型间的性能退化差异显著（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了LIBERO-RIG基准，在十一个硬件设置扰动轴上测试视觉-语言-动作模型，发现即使任务完全不变，仅硬件和设置的变化就会使汇总成功率从0.932大幅降至0.509，揭示了当前模型对部署硬件变化的脆弱性。
en_tdlr: LIBERO-RIG is a benchmark that perturbs only the robot's hardware and setup across eleven axes while keeping LIBERO tasks fixed, revealing that vision-language-action models suffer substantial robustness failures—pooled success drops from 0.932 to 0.509—under real-world hardware variations such as camera remounting, calibration drift, and control rate changes.
